decisions.executionNote: Remember left-to-right green, red, blue. Begin elbow-up left approach with small orientation increments; keep right parked.
Continue continuous elbow-up arc to hover over left cover, maintaining open gripper. Left block is green.
Lower around the left cup and close; retention will be checked during a small lift.
Lift the left cover, then translate toward the green block while keeping the cup orientation fixed and gripper closed.
Align and lower the held left cup over green, release upright, and begin vertical clearance. Next cover is center red.
Green is visually covered. Lift clear, then move left arm to the central cup without crossing into the right workspace.
Descend onto central cup with a small alignment correction, then close fully. Keep first cover undisturbed.
Lift central cup vertically and carry it toward the red block. Maintain closed gripper and constant orientation.
Seat and release the second cover over center red, then lift straight up. Right blue remains to be covered last.
Second cup is down. Clear left arm back into its workspace while beginning the right elbow-up approach to the last cup.
Guard stopped the larger left retreat. Replan from measured poses with halved left translation and continue the right approach.
Move left safely aside and finish right wrist alignment above the remaining cup. Preserve elbow-up continuity.
Grasp the right cup with a vertical descent and closed target. Reposition left only at clearance height, leaving both placed covers untouched.
Lift right cover and carry it above blue. Left moves to hover above center red but does not touch it until all covering is complete.
Place the third cup over right blue and release upright, completing the left-to-right covering sequence. Keep center and left cups untouched.
All three cups are visually seated. Begin uncovering in color order: grasp center red first; keep green and blue covered.
Lift the center cover to uncover red first, then carry it forward with constant orientation. Leave green and blue covered.
Set the removed red cover down in front of its block, maintaining upright orientation. Green will be uncovered next; blue stays covered.
Clear the released red cup vertically and move left toward the green cover at safe height. Blue remains untouched.
Approach the left green cover from above and start a vertical descent. Center red is uncovered; right blue stays covered.
Grasp and lift the left cover to uncover green second. Keep the right blue cover seated until green is clearly exposed.
Carry the green cover forward and lower it away from the revealed block. Approach and grasp blue's cover without lifting it yet.
Release the removed green cup and clear it. Lift blue's cover last and carry it forward; red and green remain uncovered.
Place the removed blue cover upright in front of its block, then clear it. Start a gradual, continuous left-arm return toward origin.
All covers are down away from the blocks. Finish the left return and lift the right clear before a gradual elbow-up return to origin.
All three blocks are visibly uncovered and cups remain upright. Settle left at origin and finish the right-arm return with continuous small increments.
